mentions.name: MCP for Open Notebook
mentions.description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Open Notebook, an open-source NotebookLM alternative, enabling AI assistants to connect with and operate on Open Notebook. Currently hosted privately on GitHub with plans to merge it into the main Open Notebook repository soon.
